dues.admin.codes.badCode: Codes are 3 to 32 letters, digits and hyphens. Leave the box empty to have one invented.
dues.admin.codes.badExpiry: The expiry needs to be a date in the future, like 2027-01-31.
dues.admin.codes.badMax: The redemption cap is a whole number, at least 1 — or empty for no cap.
dues.admin.codes.badPercent: The discount is a whole number from 1 to 100 percent.
dues.admin.codes.badPlan: That plan does not exist on this board.
dues.admin.codes.codeHelp: Code — leave empty to have one invented
dues.admin.codes.created: The code is live: {code} — hand it out however you like. It is shown in full below whenever you need it again.
dues.admin.codes.duplicate: A code by that name already exists. Every code is unique, spelt any case.
dues.admin.codes.expiresHelp: Expires at end of day (UTC) — empty for never
dues.admin.codes.intro: A code takes a percentage off at checkout: the whole price of a pass, the first payment of a subscription — renewals bill in full. A 100% code on a pass skips Stripe entirely, which is how you comp somebody.
dues.admin.codes.noSuch: That code could not be found.
dues.admin.codes.redemptions: Redemptions count when a payment settles, not when a checkout starts. A code is never deleted — switching it off keeps the history of what it sold.
dues.admin.codes.toggledOff: {code} is switched off. Anyone typing it now is told the code is not usable.
dues.admin.ledger.appendOnly: Append-only, written as money moves: charges positive, refunds and chargebacks negative. Stripe’s dashboard is the authority; this is the board’s own copy in {currency}.
dues.admin.members.cancelled: Renewal cancelled. They keep what they paid for until the period ends.
dues.admin.members.description: Every membership this plugin has sold, flagged rows first. Extending is a grant, not a charge; revoking removes access on the spot without touching the money — refunds happen in Stripe’s dashboard, and the refund webhook revokes on its own.
dues.admin.members.extended: Membership extended. The member holds their group until the new date.
dues.admin.members.grantRefused: The extension was recorded, but the board refused the group grant — the row is flagged with the reason.
dues.admin.members.noMembership: That membership is not live any more, so there is nothing to act on.
dues.admin.members.noRenewal: Only a live subscription has a renewal to cancel.
dues.admin.members.revoked: Membership revoked. Their access is gone as of now.
dues.admin.members.stripeError: Stripe could not be reached. Nothing changed — try again shortly.
dues.admin.members.stripeUnconfigured: Stripe is not configured, so the subscription cannot be reached.
dues.admin.plans.addIntro: A pass is one payment for a fixed stretch — a day to two years. A subscription renews by itself until cancelled. Lifetime is one payment, forever. The key is the plan’s permanent name in records and cannot be changed later; everything else can.
dues.admin.plans.archived: {key} is off sale. Everyone who holds it keeps it — archiving stops new purchases, nothing else.
dues.admin.plans.autoGift: A subscription cannot be giftable — it would bill the buyer forever.
dues.admin.plans.badCurrency: The currency is a three-letter ISO code, like gbp, usd or eur.
dues.admin.plans.badGroup: That is not a valid group key.
dues.admin.plans.badInterval: A subscription bills every month or every year.
dues.admin.plans.badKey: Plan keys are lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, like day-pass.
dues.admin.plans.badLength: The length is a whole number of days, weeks, months or years — at least 1.
dues.admin.plans.badName: The plan needs a name members will read.
dues.admin.plans.badPrice: The price is a positive whole number of minor units — 500 is £5.00.
dues.admin.plans.badStripePrice: A pasted Stripe price id starts with price_.
dues.admin.plans.canGift: Can be bought for another member
dues.admin.plans.created: The plan {key} is on sale from this moment.
dues.admin.plans.duplicate: A plan with that key already exists. Keys are forever; pick another.
dues.admin.plans.editing: Every purchase snapshots its plan — the name, the price, the currency, the length — so editing here never rewrites what anyone already bought. A subscription price change mints a new Stripe price: running subscriptions keep billing what they signed up for, and only the next buyer sees the new number.
dues.admin.plans.fixed: a pass — one payment, fixed length
dues.admin.plans.footer: Pass length and billing interval apply to the mode that uses them; the others ignore them. A subscription needs Stripe configured, or a pasted price id.
dues.admin.plans.giftGroup: Group it grants (marked plugin-grantable under Admin → Groups)
dues.admin.plans.name: Name
dues.admin.plans.noSuch: That plan could not be found.
dues.admin.plans.stripeError: Stripe could not be reached. Nothing was saved — try again shortly.
dues.admin.plans.stripePrice: Stripe price id — leave empty and one is minted to match
dues.admin.plans.stripeUnconfigured: Stripe is not configured, so a subscription price cannot be minted. Set the secret key first, or paste a price id made in the Stripe dashboard.
dues.admin.plans.tooLong: A pass plus the longest possible grace window ({days} days) cannot reach past two years — that is the board’s cap on a plugin grant, checked against the grace setting’s maximum, not whatever it is set to today. Sell lifetime instead.
dues.admin.plans.updated: {key} is updated. Existing memberships and running subscriptions keep what they bought; the change is for the next buyer.
dues.admin.status.attention: {count, plural, one {# record needs attention} other {# records need attention}} — a payment that could not become a membership, or an amount that did not match its order. The members screen lists {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.
dues.admin.status.flagMissing: That flag could not be found — it may already be cleared.
dues.admin.status.keyUnset: not set — nothing can be bought
dues.admin.status.none: None yet. The first purchase, or Stripe’s “send test event” button, will put a row here — which is how you prove the endpoint works.
dues.admin.status.ordersText: Money moved but the order could not settle cleanly — most often an amount that did not match. Check the payment in Stripe’s dashboard, put it right there, then clear the flag here.
dues.admin.status.plansText: Plans are made and changed on the plans screen. Each grants membership of its group only while that group is marked “may be granted by plugins” under Admin → Groups; a purchase against a group that refuses shows up above as needing attention, with the payment kept and the reason recorded.
dues.admin.status.source: Keys resolve environment-first: the settings form below this page shows which source is winning.
dues.admin.status.unprocessed: unprocessed — the reconcile task retries it
dues.admin.status.webhookText: In the Stripe dashboard, add an endpoint at /api/plugins/dues/hook/stripe on this board’s public address, subscribed to exactly these events, and put its signing secret in the settings:
dues.definition.description: Sells {label} — time-limited membership of a group — through Stripe, for yourself or as a gift.
dues.definition.notification.gift.descri: A member bought a membership in your name. It starts the moment the payment confirms.
dues.definition.notification.gift.title: Somebody gifts you a membership
dues.definition.notification.renewal.des: A renewal did not go through. Access holds during the grace window while Stripe retries.
dues.definition.setting.apiBase.descript: Only a stripe-mock or a test double ever changes this.
dues.definition.setting.apiBase.label: Stripe API address
dues.definition.setting.apiVersion.descr: Pinned so Stripe’s payload shapes change on a deploy, not on a Tuesday. Change it only alongside a plugin upgrade that expects the new shapes.
dues.definition.setting.apiVersion.label: Stripe API version
dues.definition.setting.currency.descrip: The board’s default currency — shown on the ledger, and the fallback when a Stripe event carries none of its own. Each plan still records whatever currency its own price is in.
dues.definition.setting.currency.label: Currency
dues.definition.setting.graceDays.descri: Days a lapsed renewal keeps access before the membership lapses — 0 to 30. A value outside that range is clamped rather than refused.
dues.definition.setting.graceDays.label: Grace period, in days
dues.definition.setting.secret.descripti: The sk_live_… or sk_test_… key from the Stripe dashboard.
dues.definition.setting.secret.label: Stripe secret key
dues.definition.setting.webhook.descript: The whsec_… secret of the webhook endpoint. Without it, payments are taken but can never confirm.
dues.definition.setting.webhook.label: Webhook signing secret
dues.gifts.heading: Gifts you bought
dues.go.heading: Over to Stripe…
dues.go.notAllowed: That is not somewhere this board sends people.
dues.go.paymentLead: Payment happens on Stripe’s own page — no card number ever touches this board. You should be there already;
dues.held.heading: What you hold
dues.manage.cancel-failed: That could not be cancelled. If it keeps failing, contact a moderator.
dues.manage.cancelled: Renewal cancelled. You keep everything you paid for until the period ends — nothing changes before then.
dues.manage.cardText: Cards, invoices and receipts live on Stripe, where the payment did. The portal is theirs; it comes back here when you are done.
dues.manage.grace: A renewal payment failed. Stripe retries on its own; updating your card below usually settles it.
dues.manage.no-customer: Stripe has no record for your account yet — the portal exists once you have bought something.
dues.manage.stripe-error: Stripe could not be reached. Try again shortly.
dues.manage.title: Your {label}
dues.manage.unconfigured: Payments are not fully set up on this board.
dues.notice.already-forever: You hold this membership for good already — there is nothing left to buy for it.
dues.notice.already-member: There is already an active subscription for that membership, so a second one would just charge twice for the same thing.
dues.notice.cancel-first: There is an active subscription for that membership. Cancel its renewal first, then buy the lifetime plan — you keep everything already paid for.
dues.notice.cancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
dues.notice.code-disabled: That discount code has been switched off.
dues.notice.code-exhausted: That discount code has been used as many times as it allows.
dues.notice.code-wrong-plan: That discount code is for a different plan.
dues.notice.gift-not-allowed: That plan cannot be bought for someone else. Fixed-term passes can.
dues.notice.plan-not-ready: That plan is not finished being set up — its Stripe price is missing. An administrator needs to complete it.
dues.notice.sign-in: Sign in first, so the membership has an account to attach to.
dues.notice.stripe-error: Stripe could not be reached, so nothing was charged. Try again shortly.
dues.notice.try-again: That did not go through cleanly. Nothing was charged — try once more.
dues.notice.unconfigured: Payments are not set up on this board yet. An administrator needs to finish the Stripe configuration before anything can be bought.
dues.notice.unknown-code: That discount code does not exist. Check the spelling.
dues.notice.unknown-plan: That plan is not on offer. The ones below are.
dues.notice.unknown-recipient: No member goes by that name. Check the spelling — the gift needs somewhere to go.
dues.notification.gift.body: It starts this moment — nothing to claim, nothing to do.
dues.notification.gift.subject: Somebody bought you {plan}
dues.notification.renewal.body: Stripe retries on its own. Your access holds during the grace window, and updating your card from the manage page usually settles it.
dues.notification.renewal.subject: A membership payment did not go through
dues.plan.auto: Renews automatically. Cancel any time and keep what you paid for until the period ends.
dues.plan.discountCode: Discount code, if you have one.
dues.plan.empty: Nothing is on sale just now.
dues.plan.gift: Buying for another member? Their username — leave empty for yourself.
dues.plan.lifetime: One payment, no renewal, no end date.
dues.plan.payment: Payment is taken by Stripe on their own checkout page — no card number ever touches this board.
dues.return.confirmingText: Stripe is telling the board about your payment right now. This page does not grant anything by itself — the confirmation does, and it usually lands within seconds.
dues.return.giftPaid: Your gift of {plan} has been delivered. They hold it from this moment.
dues.return.noOrder: There is no order of yours here.
